rater: B (geometry and proportion first), round w3 on commit 8220ed6

details.detail: Planform, raked tip and cruise bending. Unchanged and still verified seat for seat: 11A inlet 11.6 deg forward of the beam (photo about 11.5); 26K tip 5.0 deg above horizontal (photo about 4.7).

JA795A registration. Now at 50 % chord with 1.4 m glyphs in #3a3e44 ink. Zoomed d_26K (x 500-720, y 170-230) is almost a one-to-one match to _7345 (x 340-690, y 230-340): a letter-high band of skin ahead of the text, bottoms just ahead of the spoiler line, the J inboard reading upright, and a grey (not black) ink tone. The span range matches the canoes under it, as in _7331.
Canoe count and positions (s 8.4, 11.1, 14.7, 20.4). The outer tail lands inboard of the aileron notch from 26K.

Canoe shape. The teardrop sections with no floors removed the notch. The tail now closes to a sharp needle: depth lerp(0.25, ...) and a 0.25*e end cap (k_canoe_side). In _7331/_7329 the tails end in a small rounded nose about 35-40 % of the maximum depth, blunter than the render. The d_26K silhouette is otherwise very close.

Canoe tone. K side (sun): flank #cbcfd1 against wing #b6bcc2, like _7331 (#d3d6d3 against #c0ccd4). A side (shade): #4e5667 against about #a6acb3, like _7329 (#3b444e against #abb2b9). Sunset sun side (s_26A): still cream, brighter than the wing. This is plausible for low sun on vertical flanks; lighting owns the deck bounce.
Gear stripe, skin seams, panel tone (now ±5 %), static dischargers. All read right from 17A/17K/26K/30K and do not alias.

GE90 cowl tone. The A (shade) side is now good: the baked falloff gives #a2b3c6 to #9babbf (11A/13A), against #818c9e-#8695a4 on ANA 11A (_136) and #a9c0ce on B-KQZ. The K (sun) side is still clipped flat white: #e7ecee at every sample on d_13K and d_11K, split lines barely visible, the hump indistinguishable from the cowl (#e4eaed). The s_13A sunset cowl glows cream the same way. The sun term saturates on a #d6d9dd albedo; the #636466 wing albedo stays unclipped at #b6bcc2. Photos of sunlit cowls sit only slightly above the wing (B-KQZ cowl #a9c0ce against pylon/wing #a8b2b4).

Strake. The station is now right: 1.8-3.1 m, just ahead of the aft split (n_strake), as in B-KQZ_074140. In grey #9aa0a8 at 6 cm it reads as a separate raised grey bar or handle (m_pylon, n_strake). In B-KQZ and Leaving_Sri_Lanka the strake is cowl-coloured and only reads through its thin dark shadow line. The dark root-seam box (1.34 m) is longer than the 1.30 m plate and shows as a dark sliver beyond its lower edge in n_strake.

Pylon. Now a smooth, broad hump with a long nose blend and no tent crease (m_pylon, d_13A); the shape matches lalf_137. On the A side the hump (#cfd7de) is still clearly lighter than the cowl flank (#a2b3c6). In lalf_137 the hump and cowl are about the same tone (#4d515d against #4a4e59). Part of this is physical (it faces the sky); the rest is the white albedo. See the cowl fix.
Nav lights: a point with glow at the tip.
Day sky (owner: lighting). Unchanged: pale #bdccdc against #527dc2 (_7282).
Sunset (owner: lighting). The shade-side wing (s_26K) is cool and dark, as in _7282. On the sun side the cowl (s_13A) and canoes (s_26A) glow cream and clip.
Night (owner: lighting). Dark silhouette with the nav light; the beacon is still pending.
